author: Computing Forever
description:
I discuss the the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe and its possible reboot or rest after Avengers: Secret Wars. I also talk about the rumour that Robert Downey Jr may be returning to play Tony Stark, Iron Man, after he’s finished playing Doctor Doom post Avengers: Secret Wars. 

Source article: https://geeksandgamers.com/kevin-feige-claims-the-marvel-cinematic-universe-wont-reboot-after-avengers-secret-wars/
